scenes.caption: An easy Hawking video. Then a hard article.
scenes.vo: They got people hooked with an easy Stephen Hawking video about black holes. Then they handed them a hard science article on the same thing.

beats.caption: An easy Hawking video about black holes.
Then a hard article on the same thing.
You take some time, you hit a wall, over time you build that commitment.

scenes.note: The gap was biggest for people who found the article hard.
scenes.vo: The go find it group cooled off. The you grow it group stayed a bit more. The gap was biggest for people who found the article hard.
Five experiments. About 470 people. Stanford. Same pattern: matching stuff feels great, mismatching stuff dies faster if you think passion is a find.
